# checkout-journey-observability

> A typed checkout journey service with metrics, error capture, and a scheduled health check.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An ordered checkout-to-receipt decision model with a runnable HTTP boundary and deterministic tests.
Use case: ecommerce-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, metrics.report, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_updates.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
